setup_notes: Fork main was already in sync with upstream (ff no-op). This build has no `run --stats` flag; per-stage timings were taken from the debug build's `--trace` Chrome-trace output, summarised with stages.py.

hypotheses.title: CFG analysis looks up each class method's CFG by scanning every class (lookupFunctionCfg), making stage 8 O(classes x methods)
hypotheses.issue: PackageCFG stores class-method CFGs in a two-level map methodCfgs: map[classSym]map[methodSym]functionCFG. lookupFunctionCfg(ref) checks funcCfgs and on a miss iterates over ALL classes in methodCfgs, probing each inner map until it finds the method. Every method lookup is thus O(#classes), and the CFG analyses call it once per method (explicit-return, uninitialized-variable and final-reassignment analyses) plus per class init (uninit-field analysis), so stage 8 'CFG Analysis' is quadratic in the number of classes. On a 10k-class file it accounts for ~67% of all CPU samples (map iteration + mapaccess) and CFG Analysis takes ~3 s while CFG Creation takes ~0.3 s; doubling classes 5k->10k makes CFG Analysis 4.6x slower. Fix: give lookups an O(1) path by method SymbolRef (e.g. a flat index filled where methodCfgs is populated, or pass the owning class symbol).

reproducer.generator:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate a .bal file with N small classes, each with M methods.

Stresses semantics/internal/cfg PackageCFG.lookupFunctionCfg, which for a
method symbol linearly scans every class's method-CFG map (O(#classes) per
lookup, called by 3+ CFG analyses per method) => O(classes^2 * methods).
usage: gen_classes.py N [M] > out.bal
"""
import sys
n = int(sys.argv[1]); m = int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 2
out = []
for i in range(n):
    out.append(f"class C{i} {{")
    for j in range(m):
        out.append(f"    function m{j}(int x) returns int {{ return x + {j}; }}")
    out.append("}")
out.append("public function main() {\n}")
print("\n".join(out))
reproducer.command: python3 gen_classes.py 10000 > repro.bal; hyperfine -w 1 -r 5 'bal run repro.bal'; stage split: bal-debug run --trace=tr.json repro.bal && python3 stages.py tr.json; ./bin/benchmark --mode time --runs 5 --warmup 1 main <branch> repro.bal

hypotheses.fix_approach: Added a flat index classMethodCfgs map[model.SymbolRef]functionCFG to PackageCFG, populated in Build alongside the per-class methodCfgs map (inside the existing mutex in the per-method goroutine). lookupFunctionCfg now does funcCfgs then one probe of the index instead of looping over classes. methodCfgs is kept for the pretty printer and allFunctionCfgs, which iterate by class. Service methods already go into funcCfgs, so they are not indexed. Pitfall: the index is written from concurrent per-method goroutines, so writes must stay under the Build mutex (make test-race clean). An alternative is to pass the owning class symbol to the lookup. functionCFG is also returned by value; returning a pointer would save copies but was not needed.
